# ADR-3239: AWS secrets: Secrets in AMI or container layer for image 7

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Layer history retains deleted secrets.

## Decision

Images MUST NOT bake secrets in AMI or container layer for image 7 (AWS-secrets-7).

## Consequences

Inject secrets at runtime only.
